name: sg-semicon-expansion-plugin
description: Support Singapore semiconductor SMEs with US expansion research: capability mapping, broad US prospect discovery, and qualified prospect filtering.

interface.shortDescription: Map SME capabilities and find US prospects.
interface.longDescription: Helps business users turn a Singapore semiconductor SME website or profile into a capability profile, a broad list of possible US prospects, and a smaller qualified shortlist for deeper research or outreach.
defaultPrompt: Profile this Singapore semiconductor SME for US expansion.
Discover possible US prospects from this capability profile.
Qualify these US prospects for deeper analysis.
